atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 theme configuration directive for defining design tokens such as colors, fonts, spacing, and breakpoints.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 directive for registering custom variants (for example, class-based dark mode).

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 directive for registering custom utility classes.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 directive for applying a Tailwind variant inside custom CSS.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 directive for specifying additional template source paths to scan.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 directive for loading legacy JavaScript plugins.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 directive for importing theme tokens and utilities by reference without emitting CSS.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS directive for inlining utility classes into custom CSS rules.
